projects.title: Help-Content Authoring Plugin
projects.tagline: How a writing team went from editing help articles one at a time to asking Claude for the change
projects.client: Intuit Customer Success (TurboTax, Credit Karma, ProTax)
projects.summary: I pitched, designed, and built the Claude plugin Intuit's help-content writers use to edit a 20,700+ piece knowledge base in plain English, including every connection to WordPress. Every change is saved as a Draft, checked, and verified, and nothing publishes until a writer says yes. The first week the whole team had it, we updated 5.5x as many articles as two weeks before.

projects.title: Authoring Accelerator Agent
projects.tagline: Keeping TurboTax's Digital Assistant authoring going after the expert team behind it offboarded
projects.summary: Seven borrowed tax experts were writing Digital Assistant answers, 2 business days per 100 questions, and they were leaving on April 16. I built a tool before then that searches 3,684 articles and drafts style-guide answers with sources and a confidence rating. It does 100 in under 5 minutes, and about three in four come back ready for a light review.

projects.title: AI Content Systems at Intuit
projects.tagline: Turning thousands of help articles into something writers and support experts could search and reuse
projects.summary: I structured about 4,000 help articles, with their URLs and metadata, so writers could find and reuse what we'd already written and support experts without AI access could still get answers.

projects.title: Tax Season Content Automation
projects.tagline: Replacing a daily 30 to 60 minute manual workflow with one Python command
projects.summary: Every day of tax season, someone spent 30 to 60 minutes moving approval data from CSVs through Smartsheet into WordPress, and the same errors kept showing up. I wrote a Python script that does all 10 steps in about 5 seconds.

projects.title: Professional Tax Product Form Help
projects.tagline: Putting the right guidance inside the tax form, at the field where accountants get stuck
projects.summary: I own the field-level help inside Lacerte. I decide which of the hundreds of form fields need guidance, write it for someone mid-return, and ship it through a CSV-to-XML pipeline with engineering.

projects.title: CGI Meditation Experiences
projects.tagline: VR meditation app designed to enhance remote worker well-being
projects.summary: Created concept, pitch, and demo for a VR meditation app that integrates with work calendars. Won first place in CGI's VR innovation challenge, beating all competing teams.

projects.title: UX/UI Work for Telecom
projects.tagline: Enterprise B2B platform design for multi-location service management
projects.summary: Designed UX content for complex B2B platforms supporting enterprise customers managing connectivity, voice, and network services across hundreds of locations. Translated dense technical and contractual requirements into clear decision-enabling UI language. Work completed under NDA—case study available upon request.
